report_name: Abbott Labs Breach Linked to Insecure Systems from Acquisition

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A data broker group that claimed responsibility for the Abbott Laboratories breach, alleging the theft of 30 million data rows. They exploited legacy systems from Exact Sciences, a company recently acquired by Abbott.
threat_actors.goals: Large-scale data theft for extortion or sale on dark web marketplaces.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exploited the trusted relationship between Abbott Laboratories and its recently acquired subsidiary, Exact Sciences, by targeting the less-secure, pre-integration environment of the subsidiary as an initial access vector.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors exfiltrated a large volume of data, allegedly 30 million rows, to their own controlled infrastructure.

identities.name: Abbott Laboratories
identities.description: A healthcare and medical device company whose Cancer Diagnostics division was breached. The intrusion was traced back to legacy IT systems from its recently acquired company, Exact Sciences.

identities.name: Exact Sciences
identities.description: A recently acquired company whose legacy IT systems were the entry point for the breach against its parent company, Abbott Laboratories.

infrastructure.name: ShinyHunters Exfiltration Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Attacker-controlled infrastructure used by ShinyHunters to receive the large volume of data exfiltrated from the victim's database.
